name: incercam
description: Production window configurator with browser GLB export, Netlify upload tickets, Supabase Storage, and Scene Viewer AR.

scripts.check:merged: node --check server.js && node --check prepare_static_site.js && node --check ar-export.js && node --check cloudflare-worker/src/index.js
scripts.check:supabase: node --check server.js && node --check prepare_static_site.js && node --check ar-export.js && node --check netlify/functions/ar-upload-ticket.mjs
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run prepare:static && npx --yes netlify-cli@latest deploy --prod --dir=static-site --functions=netlify/functions
